message.content: The pain started about eight days ago in the upper left side of my belly. At first it was mild, but it's gotten a lot worse. I was told it was a stomach bug, but it never got better, and now I'm also feeling sick and throwing up. I'm not sure how to describe the type of pain exactly, it's just a constant ache that's getting worse. I haven't noticed if it goes to my back or shoulder. I don't know about fever, and I wasn't told about any blood in my stool or vomit or urinary problems. Also, I should mention I've missed my period and I took a home pregnancy test that was positive. I think I'm about five weeks along.
